_comment: Hand-written game setup tables. Map sizes and speeds from specs/civ6/data/game-setup.md (maxReligions: Great Prophets per map size; defaultCityStates: the game's default city-state count per size, not in the reference tables); starting units from its 'Starting units (major civs)' Ancient row. Globals here are Sovereign-only tuning: CITY_SIGHT_RANGE (Civ VI value unverified, 01-map-and-terrain.md Visibility) the MAPGEN_* map generator knobs, CITY_PRODUCTION_QUEUE_MAX (Civ value unverified), GOLD_PURCHASE_ENGINE_FACTOR (gold price = production cost x GOLD_PURCHASE_MULTIPLIER x this, giving the 4x of 02-cities.md, Production), EXPERIENCE_PER_LEVEL (XP for the next promotion = this x current level; engine value per 05-units-and-combat.md, XP and promotions) BARBARIAN_CAMP_CLEAR_GOLD (gold for clearing a camp; Civ amount unverified, 01-map-and-terrain.md Barbarians), BARBARIAN_MAX_UNITS_PER_CAMP (a camp stops releasing units at this many; Sovereign cap, Civ VI uses attack forces) CITY_STRENGTH_BELOW_STRONGEST_UNIT (city strength = strongest unit built minus this; engine value per 02-cities.md, City combat) TRADE_ROUTE_PLUNDER_GOLD (gold for plundering a trade route; Civ amount unverified, 07-economy-trade-great-people.md Trade routes) and ERA_SCORE_THRESHOLD_ADJUST (added to both age thresholds because the AI earns fewer historic moments than Civ's thresholds expect; measured over 6-player games, 0 gave 41% Dark Ages, -5 gave 28%, and -10 gives 17% Dark and 18% Golden or Heroic, so it stays at -10; raise it toward 0 as the AI earns more moments).
_difficulties: Difficulty levels (00-overview.md, Difficulty levels; AI starting units). Sovereign rule (leader doc section 10, Difficulty [decided]): levels scale the AI's skill first (aiSkill 0..7); Civ's AI bonuses (yields, combat, XP, free boosts, extra starting units) apply only at Immortal and Deity, with Civ's values for those levels. Human bonuses at Settler and Chieftain and the barbarian camp gold follow Civ. aiCombat uses the guides' +1 at King .. +4 at Deity reading (Immortal +3, Deity +4). diplomacyOffset is Civ's DifficultyOffset on the diplomacy random modifier (Settler +3 .. Deity -4), added to each AI's opinion of a human.
_achievements: Achievements and the cosmetics they unlock (player-retention section 7), checked when a game ends for a player. Cosmetics tint the ruler's figure; they never change the rules. Kinds: VICTORY (victory: SCIENCE, CULTURE, DOMINATION, RELIGIOUS, DIPLOMATIC, SCORE or empty for any; speed: a game speed or empty), RULERS_TAKEN, LEADER_LEVEL, WONDERS (value: how many).

achievements.name: Kingtaker
achievements.text: Capture or slay a rival ruler in battle.

achievements.name: Builder of Wonders
achievements.text: Hold five world wonders at the end of a game.

_eraStarts: Era starts (game-setup.md, Advanced start eras; Starting units (major civs), non-AI rows; Starting buildings by start era, City Center only; player-retention section 5). A game begun in an era gives every civ the techs and civics of the eras before it, this gold and faith and these units on top of the usual Settler and Warrior; cities founded in the game start with this population and the City Center buildings of this era and the ones before.
